name: How does tile flooring compare to luxury vinyl plank in a kitchen?

mainEntity.name: How does tile flooring compare to luxury vinyl plank in a kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile offers superior waterproofing, long-term durability, and a high-end finish, especially when using natural stone or porcelain. The tradeoff is that tile is harder underfoot, requires mortar and grout maintenance, and takes longer to install. Luxury vinyl plank provides a softer, warmer feel, faster installation, and strong water resistance at a lower price point. However, vinyl planks can be gouged by heavy appliances and cannot be refinished. Homeowners must weigh the timeless permanence of tile against the lower initial investment and walking comfort of vinyl.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile offers greater longevity and heat resistance but requires longer installation, while luxury vinyl plank is softer and more budget-friendly but prone to heavy-impact scuffs.
